text.en: Rounds fired from this weapon have reduced damage falloff, overpenetrate targets, and ricochet off hard surfaces. Projectile damage increases after bounce.

Damage Falloff for this weapon ends at a 30% penalty (instead of the usual 50% for Auto Rifles).

Bullets ricochet up to two times, dealing <pve 100% /> <pvp [35%] /> increased damage after at least one ricochet.
